# PCAN-Explorer10

Canonical website: https://www.hexbyte.cn/
Current version: 0.7.1 (released 2026-09-18)
Product type: Windows 10/11 64-bit desktop CAN/CAN FD engineering analysis software.
Technology: Rust + Slint.

PCAN-Explorer10 supports PCAN (PEAK), ZLG, ZHCX and GCAN adapters. Real CAN/CAN FD acquisition and transmission require compatible hardware and the vendor driver. The current release does not provide a virtual CAN bus.

Core capabilities:
- CAN/CAN FD trace, filtering, grouping, statistics, curves, single/periodic transmission, CSV/ASC/BLF recording and replay.
- DBC decoding: Unsigned, Signed, IEEE Float and IEEE Double; Intel/Motorola byte order; factor, offset, unit and range.
- Project files and visual simulation panels with DBC-bound controls.
- printf-over-CAN embedded text logs, plus UDS and XCP entry points.
- Modbus TCP/RTU master and slave tools.
- Serial debugging and ANSI interactive terminal.

Version 0.7.1 changes and verification:
- The runtime diagnostics panel reports UI, queue, hardware, recording and timestamp-quality metrics.
- Diagnostic and update dialogs share consistent spacing, rounded cards, buttons and faster transitions.
- Runtime diagnostics are aligned at the far right of the status bar; border and accent overflow defects were corrected.
- Formatting, all three Slint UI syntax checks, the UI render matrix, workspace tests and a zero-warning Clippy audit passed.
